name: Heard
one_liner: Done-for-you bookkeeping and tax services for therapists in private practice starting at $129/month.
short_description: Heard is a financial services platform providing done-for-you bookkeeping, quarterly tax estimates, and annual tax filing specifically for therapists in private practice.
long_description: Heard is a financial services platform built specifically for therapists in private practice. The service provides done-for-you monthly bookkeeping, quarterly tax estimates, and optional annual tax filing—all designed around the unique needs of mental health providers. Plans start at $129/month for the Lite tier (bookkeeping + quarterly taxes) with Essential and Premium tiers available for sole proprietors and S-Corps. Annual tax filing is available as a $750 add-on. Heard's dedicated bookkeeping team keeps books organized and accurate with connections to bank accounts and payment processors. Additional services include payroll ($39/month + $6/employee) and catch-up bookkeeping ($99/month). Heard offers both monthly and annual billing with 15% savings for annual subscribers. Compared to traditional CPAs ($500+/month), Heard provides a more affordable entry point for solo therapists.
best_for: Private practice owners in first 1-2 years
Clinicians who hate managing finances themselves

pricing.notes: Save 15% with annual billing. Annual tax filing is $750 add-on (not included in base plans). Payroll add-on: $39/month + $6/employee. Catch-up bookkeeping: $99/month. Monthly subscribers can cancel anytime; annual subscribers commit for full year.

compliance.notes: Financial services platform for bookkeeping and taxes. Does not handle PHI or patient health data—HIPAA not applicable.
